X ∈RB×n×d →Encoder layers →H ∈RB×n×d

Bidirectional self-attention:
token i can attend to tokens before and after it.
Takeaway
BERT is designed for understanding representations, not natural left-to-right
generation.

title: BERT pretraining objectives
text:
BERT pretraining objectives
Masked Language Modeling (MLM)
Randomly mask some tokens and predict them from bidirectional context:
p(xmasked | xvisible)
Original BERT also used NSP
Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) was used in the original BERT training
setup. Many later models modify or remove this component.
Key insight
MLM forces the model to build contextual representations using both left and
right context.

title: BERT: when to use
text:
BERT: when to use
• Text classification.
• Named Entity Recognition (NER).
• Extractive Question Answering.
• Sentence-pair classification.
• Embedding extraction for retrieval/ranking pipelines.
Caution
BERT is not the natural choice for long free-form generation.

title: BERT: common pitfalls
text:
BERT: common pitfalls
• Using the wrong tokenizer for the checkpoint.
• Forgetting padding mask.
• Treating BERT as a left-to-right generator.
• Using [CLS] blindly for semantic similarity without checking embedding
quality.
• Truncating long documents without a chunking strategy.
Practical note
For document-level tasks, BERT’s maximum length often forces chunking,
pooling, or long-context variants.

title: GPT inference: autoregressive decoding
text:
GPT inference: autoregressive decoding
Generation loop
x1, . . . , xt →p(xt+1) →xt+1 →p(xt+2) →· · ·
Decoding choices
• Greedy decoding.
• Beam search.
• Top-k sampling.
• Nucleus / top-p sampling.
• Temperature scaling.
Takeaway
GPT output quality depends on both model and decoding strategy.

title: GPT and KV cache
text:
GPT and KV cache
Problem
Naive generation recomputes attention over all previous tokens at every step.
KV cache
Store keys and values from previous tokens:
K≤t, V≤t
Then only compute new query/key/value for the new token.
Takeaway
KV cache is essential for efficient GPT inference.

title: GPT: when to use
text:
GPT: when to use
• Open-ended text generation.
• Chatbots and instruction following.
• Code generation.
• Summarization and QA via prompting.
• In-context learning.
Caution
GPT-style models can generate fluent but incorrect text; factuality and
grounding require additional system design.

Takeaway
T5 is natural for tasks with explicit source-to-target transformation.

title: T5: when to use
text:
T5: when to use
• Machine translation.
• Summarization.
• Structured generation from input text.
• Text normalization and rewriting.
• Tasks where output length differs greatly from input length.

title: ViT patch embedding in PyTorch
text:
ViT patch embedding in PyTorch
import
torch
import
torch.nn as nn
B, C, H, W = 4, 3, 224, 224
P = 16
d_model = 768
patch_embed = nn.Conv2d(
in_channels=C,
out_channels=d_model ,
kernel_size=P,
stride=P
)
x = torch.randn(B, C, H, W)
z = patch_embed(x)
# (B, d, 14, 14)
z = z.flatten (2).transpose (1, 2) # (B, 196, d)

title: Parameter and system-level view
text:
Parameter and system-level view
• Encoder-only models are efficient for representation extraction.
• Decoder-only models are efficient for scalable generation with KV cache.
• Encoder-decoder models are flexible but structurally heavier.
• ViT cost depends strongly on image resolution and patch size.
Deployment rule
Evaluate accuracy, latency, memory, and batching behavior together.

title: Common mistakes
text:
Common mistakes
• Using BERT for free-form generation.
• Forgetting causal mask in GPT-style training.
• Ignoring encoder-decoder cross-attention in T5.
• Using wrong preprocessing for ViT pretrained weights.
• Comparing families without controlling data, tokenization, and training
recipe.
Takeaway
Model family choice only makes sense together with objective, tokenizer,
mask, and deployment constraint.

title: Summary
text:
Summary
• BERT: encoder-only, bidirectional understanding.
• GPT: decoder-only, causal generation.
• T5: encoder-decoder, text-to-text transformation.
• ViT: encoder-only over image patch tokens.
• Architecture family is defined by topology, mask, objective, and
tokenization.
Final insight
Transformer is a general sequence modeling framework; BERT, GPT, T5, and
ViT are different ways to control information flow.
